rules.mechanism: Gu rank = median known rank of its band, path and type family (resemblance; PWC83 second voice)
inputs: known ranks of the family (training rows only)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; cohort = rows whose wiki and chapter ranks agree
rules.set: held-out cohort rows the rule applies to
rules.note: Within-band = rank within one. A rule that rests on name resemblance, not on what the Gu does.

rules.mechanism: Gu rank = highest known precursor rank + 1 (refinement process; PWC93)
rules.fit: none (the +1 is a constant, nothing is fitted from training ranks)
inputs: known ranks of the family (training rows only)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; cohort = rows whose wiki and chapter ranks agree
rules.set: whole cohort rows with a precursor edge (nothing fitted, so no hold-out needed); held-out slice is n=9
rules.note: Held-out slice alone is below the floor; the rule fits nothing, so the whole cohort is a fair test.

rules.mechanism: Ordered set: precursor rank + 1, inverse (below its products), next-rank link, story-time neighbours (first appearance), family median fallback (PWC99)
rules.fit: nothing fitted beyond k=7 neighbours, chosen on folds 1-4
rules.split: five frozen folds (gu_rank_folds.json); fold 5 scored once
rules.baselineRule: family-median set on the same fold
rules.set: frozen fold 5, every cohort row (abstain falls back to family median)
rules.note: Proposal, not wired into any builder. Story-time is a narrative proxy, not an in-world process (PWC93).

rules.mechanism: Gu rank climbs by the step a numbered series shows
inputs: known ranks of the family (training rows only)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; cohort = rows whose wiki and chapter ranks agree
rules.set: whole cohort rows in a series
rules.note: Not among the six rules the ledgers cite (it produced no row); scored for completeness.

rules.mechanism: A same-Sequence characteristic can stand in for the potion main (brew_law main slot)
rules.split: GKM429 (frozen in 13b7b765c); labels = Luna recall of the natural main, not a chapter read

baseline.name: majority pathway and Sequence (upper bound: the smaller single-axis majority count)

rules.note: The rule says a characteristic CAN replace a main; it never claimed it is the natural main, so a miss here is partly a mismatch of claim and test (edge case E1).
